# cycle_scoped_variables (Data Source)

Lists Cycle scoped variables in an environment. Deleted variables are omitted. Values are marked sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cycle_scoped_variables" "api" {
  environment_id = cycle_environment.api.id
}

output "scoped_variable_identifiers" {
  value = [for v in data.cycle_scoped_variables.api.variables : v.identifier]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment whose scoped variables should be listed.

### Read-Only

- `variables` (Attributes List) The scoped variables in the environment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))

<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Read-Only:

- `access` (Attributes) How the scoped variable is exposed to containers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables--access))
- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment this scoped variable belongs to.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this scoped variable belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the scoped variable.
- `identifier` (String) The identifier of the scoped variable, similar to the key of an environment variable.
- `scope` (Attributes) Which containers in the environment the variable is assigned to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables--scope))
- `secret` (Attributes) Present when the variable is marked as a secret on the Cycle dashboard. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables--secret))
- `state` (String) The current state of the scoped variable.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The raw value of the scoped variable, when the API returns a raw source.

<a id="nestedatt--variables--access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables.access`

Read-Only:

- `env_variable` (Attributes) Present when the variable is exposed as a container environment variable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables--access--env_variable))
- `file` (Attributes) Present when the variable is mounted as a file inside the container. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables--access--file))
- `internal_api` (Attributes) Present when the variable is exposed over Cycle's internal API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables--access--internal_api))

<a id="nestedatt--variables--access--env_variable"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables.access.env_variable`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The environment variable name set on the target container.


<a id="nestedatt--variables--access--file"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables.access.file`

Read-Only:

- `decode` (Boolean) Whether Cycle base64-decodes the value before writing the file.
- `path` (String) The path the file is mounted to inside the container.


<a id="nestedatt--variables--access--internal_api"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables.access.internal_api`

Read-Only:

- `duration` (String) How long the internal API serves the variable after runtime start.



<a id="nestedatt--variables--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables.scope`

Read-Only:

- `container_identifiers` (List of String) Container identifiers that have access to this scoped variable.
- `container_ids` (List of String) Container IDs that have access to this scoped variable.
- `global` (Boolean) Whether the variable is assigned to all current and future containers in the environment.


<a id="nestedatt--variables--secret"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables.secret`

Read-Only:

- `hint` (String) A user-specified hint for portal-encrypted values.
- `iv` (String) The IV hex associated with portal-side encryption, if any.
